name: instructor-guide
title_zh: 六块20分钟积木拼出90分钟课堂，还自带最少可行路径
tagline_zh: 写教案最怕时间失控：前松后紧、活动超时、重点没讲完。这份指南把每节课切成六个20分钟块，连学生产出。
tagline_en: Lesson plans always run over. This guide carves every session into six 20-min blocks, each with student outputs.
desc_en: Write or update the weekN-instructor-guide.md that pairs with a lecture deck - six 20-minute blocks, student outputs, facilitation notes, minimum viable path, extension. Use when the user asks for a session plan, teaching guide, lesson plan, pacing, timing, activities, "how do I run this week", or an instructor guide.
why_zh: 它不给你抽象的教学法，而是把时间轴钉死：每块20分钟、每块有明确产出。
why_en: It doesn't preach pedagogy—it pins the timeline: six blocks, each with a concrete output, plus a fallback path for when you run.
limit_zh: 只适配配套lecture deck的周教案，不生成课件本身；若你的课不是90分钟或六段式结构，需自行改模板。
limit_en: Only pairs with a matching lecture deck; won't build slides. Assumes 90-min/six-block format; no grading or homework design.
title_en: Six 20-min blocks build a 90-min class with a minimum.
